# Indowud

> Indowud manufactures eco-friendly NFC (Natural Fiber Composite) boards as sustainable alternatives to plywood, MDF, and PVC with fire-retardant, waterproof, and termite-proof properties.

Indowud specializes in producing Natural Fiber Composite (NFC) boards for interior, exterior, furniture, and partition applications. The company emphasizes sustainability through GreenPro certification and advanced manufacturing processes, positioning NFC as a superior alternative to traditional wood-based materials.

## Key Topics

- Natural Fiber Composites (NFC)
- Eco-friendly building materials
- Fire-retardant boards
- Waterproof & termite-proof
- Sustainability & GreenPro certification
- NFC vs. Plywood/MDF/PVC comparison
- Manufacturing process
- Technical specifications
- Environmental Product Declaration (EPD)
- UL94 & ASTM E84 standards
- Green construction
- Interior & exterior panels
- Thermoforming capabilities
- B L Bengani (Chairman)
- Product testing & certification
